1. (Currently amended) An ultrasonic surgical instrument assembly comprising: a handpiece; a transducer or generator of ultrasonic mechanical vibrations disposed in said handpiece; a probe attached to a distal end of said handpiece and operatively connected to said transducer or generator; and a light source attached to said handpiece so as to direct at least visible electromagnetic radiation along the probe towards a surgical site distal of the probe, wherein said light source is positioned to provide illumination __distinct from the transducer or generator__.

2. (Currently amended) The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 1, further comprising a power supply __separate from said handpiece and__ mounted at least indirectly to said handpiece and operatively connected to said light source.

3. (Original)

4. (Original)

5. (Currently amended) The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 2, further comprising a fastener for removably attaching said light source to said handpiece, wherein said fastener is __distinct from said power supply__.

6. (Currently amended) The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 5, further comprising at least one additional fastener for removably attaching said power supply at least indirectly to said handpiece, wherein said additional fastener is __distinct from the fastener attaching said light source__.

7. (Currently amended) The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 2, further comprising a battery as said power supply, wherein said battery is __operatively connected to said light source through a dedicated electrical connection__.

8. (Currently amended) The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 1 wherein said light source includes a light-emitting diode __having a wavelength in the visible spectrum__.

9. (Currently amended) The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 1 wherein said light source is attached to a proximal or rear end of said handpiece, further comprising an optical fiber extending from said light source to a distal end portion of said handpiece, wherein said optical fiber __transmits light from said light source to said distal end portion__.

10. (Currently amended) The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 1 wherein said light source is attached to a distal end of said handpiece and is oriented to provide illumination along said probe to the surgical site, wherein said light source is __positioned at an angle of approximately 0 to 45 degrees relative to said probe__.

11. (Currently amended) An accessory for a surgical instrument comprising a handpiece, a transducer or generator of ultrasonic mechanical vibrations disposed in said handpiece, and a probe attached to a distal end of said handpiece and operatively connected to said transducer or generator, said accessory comprising: a light source; a fastener for removably attaching said light source to said handpiece; and at least one power supply component __separate from said handpiece and__ operatively connectable to said light source.

12. (Currently amended) The accessory defined in claim 11 wherein said power supply component includes a coil, and said accessory further comprises an additional fastener for removably attaching said coil about a power cable feeding said transducer or generator, wherein said coil is __wound around said power cable and held in place by said additional fastener__.

13. (Currently amended) The accessory defined in claim 12 wherein said power supply component further includes a slow-drain capacitor operatively connected to said coil and connectable to said light source for providing illumination energy to said light source for a predetermined period of time after a termination of power conduction through said cable, wherein said capacitor is __electrically isolated from said coil except through a defined circuit__.

14. (Currently amended) The accessory defined in claim 11 wherein said power supply component includes a battery, wherein said battery is __separate from said handpiece__.

15. (Currently amended) The accessory defined in claim 11 wherein said light source includes a light-emitting diode __having a wavelength in the visible spectrum__.

16. (Currently amended) The accessory defined in claim 11 wherein said fastener is configured for attaching said light source to a proximal or rear end of said handpiece, further comprising an optical fiber and at least one additional fastener for removably attaching said optical fiber to said handpiece so that said optical fiber extends from said light source to a distal end portion of said handpiece, wherein said optical fiber __transmits light from said light source to said distal end portion__.

17. (Currently amended) The accessory defined in claim 11 wherein said fastener is configured for attaching said light source to a distal end of said handpiece and for orienting said light source to provide illumination along said probe to a surgical site, wherein said light source is __positioned at an angle of approximately 0 to 45 degrees relative to said probe__.

18. (Currently amended) The accessory defined in claim 11 wherein said fastener is taken from the group consisting of a clip, a clamp, and a band, wherein said fastener is __removably engageable with said handpiece__.

19. (Currently amended) A surgical method comprising: providing a surgical instrument having a handpiece, a transducer or generator of ultrasonic mechanical vibrations disposed in said handpiece and a probe attached to a distal end of said handpiece and operatively connected to said transducer or generator; providing a light source; applying a fastener to said handpiece to attach said light source thereto so that light from said light source is directable at an angle of approximately 0 to 45 degrees relative to said probe; operating said surgical instrument to apply ultrasonic vibratory energy to a surgical site; during the operating of said surgical instrument, conducting electrical energy from a power supply to said light source; and during the operating of said surgical instrument and the conducting of said electrical energy, illuminating said surgical site with light from said source.

20. (Currently amended) The surgical method defined in claim 19 further comprising removably mounting said power supply __separate from said handpiece__ at least indirectly to said handpiece.

21. (Currently amended) The surgical method defined in claim 20 wherein said power supply includes a coil, the removable mounting of said power supply at least indirectly to said handpiece including disposing said coil about a power cable feeding said transducer or generator and securing said coil in place with a fastener, wherein said coil is __wound around said power cable and held in place by said fastener__.

22. (Currently amended) The surgical method defined in claim 21 wherein said power supply further includes a slow-drain capacitor operatively connected to said coil, further comprising operating said capacitor to provide illumination energy to said light source for a predetermined period of time after a termination of power conduction through said cable, wherein said capacitor is __electrically isolated from said coil except through a defined circuit__.

23. (Currently amended) The surgical method defined in claim 19, further comprising removing said fastener and said light source from said handpiece after completion of an operation on said surgical site, wherein said removal is __performed without damaging said handpiece__.

24. (Currently amended) The surgical method defined in claim 19 wherein the applying of said fastener includes positioning said light source at a proximal or rear end of said handpiece, further comprising attaching an optical fiber to said handpiece so that said fiber extends from said light source at said proximal end of said handpiece to a distal end of said handpiece, wherein said optical fiber __transmits light from said light source to said distal end of said handpiece__.

25. (Currently amended) An accessory for a medical instrument comprising a handpiece and a probe or tool extension on a distal end of said handpiece, said accessory comprising: a light source; a fastener for removably attaching said light source to said instrument; and at least one power supply component operatively connectable to said light source, said power supply component including a coil, and said accessory further comprising an additional fastener for removably attaching said coil about a power cable extending to said handpiece, wherein said coil is __wound around said power cable and held in place by said additional fastener__.

26. (Currently amended) The accessory defined in claim 25 wherein said power supply component further includes a slow-drain capacitor operatively connected to said coil and connectable to said light source for providing illumination energy to said light source for a predetermined period of time after a termination of power conduction through said cable, wherein said capacitor is __electrically isolated from said coil except through a defined circuit__.
